# Ibiza Private Drivers
> Professional private transfer and chauffeur service based in Ibiza, Spain.
> Operating 24/7 across the entire island of Ibiza and Formentera.

## About
Ibiza Private Drivers is a private transfer and chauffeur service specialising in airport transfers, chauffeur hire, villa transfers and yacht or port transfers across Ibiza (Balearic Islands, Spain). The service supports individuals, families, groups, corporate clients, yacht crews and villa guests.

## Services

### Airport Transfers — Ibiza Airport (IBZ)
Private door-to-door transfers from Ibiza Airport (IATA: IBZ) to confirmed destinations on the island. Customers provide the flight number, passenger count, luggage and exact destination so pickup details can be coordinated. Meet and greet, child seats, extra luggage and additional stops must be requested before confirmation. Available 24/7 by reservation and subject to availability.

### Chauffeur Service Ibiza
Private chauffeur hire can be arranged for several hours, half days, full days and tailored itineraries across the island. It is suitable for business travel, events, restaurants, beaches, villas, nightlife and private schedules. Vehicle and driver availability is confirmed for each request.

### Villa Transfers Ibiza
Door-to-door service for guests staying in private villas across Ibiza. Customers should provide the villa name, exact map pin, access notes, passenger count and luggage requirements before confirmation because rural and private-property access can vary.

### Yacht and Port Transfers
Professional transfers for yacht owners, crew and guests arriving or departing at marinas across Ibiza including Marina Ibiza, Club Náutico Santa Eulalia, and the port of Sant Antoni.

## Fleet
- Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle.
- Additional suitable vehicles can be arranged according to passenger numbers, luggage and availability.
- Child seats and specific vehicle requirements must be requested before confirmation.

## Coverage — Destinations Served
- Ibiza Airport (IBZ)
- Ibiza Town (Eivissa)
- Santa Eulalia del Río
- Sant Antoni de Portmany
- Es Canar
- Cala Llonga
- Cala Vadella
- Cala Tarida
- Portinatx
- San Carlos / Sant Carles de Peralta
- Marina Ibiza
- Club Náutico Santa Eulalia
- Formentera (ferry connection service)
- All private villas and rural properties across the island

## Pricing
Pricing is quoted for the requested route, date, time, vehicle, passenger count, luggage and any waiting or additional-stop requirements. Customers receive availability and a tailored quote before confirming.

## Languages
Website and route information is available in English, French, German and Arabic. Booking communication depends on the team member handling the request.

Booking requests are accepted through the website booking tool, WhatsApp, phone and email. A service is confirmed only after availability, route details and pricing have been agreed.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much is a private transfer from Ibiza Airport to Ibiza Town?
A: The price depends on the date, pickup time, passenger count, luggage, vehicle and final address. Send the journey details for a tailored quote.

Q: Is there a 24-hour airport transfer service in Ibiza?
A: Airport transfers can be arranged 24 hours a day by reservation and subject to vehicle and driver availability.

Q: What flight information is required for an airport pickup?
A: Send the airline, flight number, scheduled arrival time, passenger count, luggage and final destination so the pickup can be coordinated.

Q: Can I hire a private driver for a full day in Ibiza?
A: Yes. Full-day and half-day chauffeur hire is available. Contact us for a personalised quote.

Q: Do you transfer guests to private villas in Ibiza?
A: Yes. Villa transfers are one of our core services. We serve all areas of the island including remote rural properties.

Q: What vehicles does Ibiza Private Drivers use?
A: The service includes a Mercedes-Benz V-Class. Additional suitable vehicles can be arranged according to group size, luggage and availability.
